stages.title: Project setup and first deploy
stages.notes: Built through subagent-driven development from docs/plans/part2-stage-0-setup.md: four tasks, a review per task, a final whole-branch review on Opus and one fix wave. Decisions by Arthur during the stage: events.user_id nullable (a Lead or Purchase whose click lost its user), events.event_id NOT NULL (SQLite allows NULL in a TEXT primary key), 14-day retention on both queues per ADR 0005, deploy secrets in the GitHub Environment argus-cloudflare restricted to main, an account API token with four Edit scopes and 90 days expiry, .worktreeinclude for local-only files. Setup traps found on the way: the test package is now @cloudflare/vitest-plugin, compatibility_date is capped by the test runtime (2026-11-03), wrangler types needs --strict-vars=false. The two D1 databases already existed on the account (created 2026-11-04 18:14Z) and were reused. Explain-back: Arthur described the two D1 databases and the R2 path himself and asked about logs, Queues, Analytics Engine and bindings, which were explained.
stages.verified: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm test (6 passed, 2 files); CI check job green on PR #1; remote sqlite_master: facts has the 8 tables of data-model.md, events has events (event_id NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY; client_time, seq, user_id nullable); both queues at 1209600 s retention (dashboard); environment argus-cloudflare holds both secrets and allows only main. GET /healthz on the deployed Worker is checked against the merge commit right after this commit deploys.

stages.title: Identity, selection and the quiz
stages.notes: Built through subagent-driven development from docs/plans/part2-stage-1-quiz.md, with a review per task, a final whole-branch review and one fix wave. A second review of the PR by five small reviewers, one per area, found six defects, all fixed in the PR: a later completion now removes older answers it no longer carries; parseFlow rejects branch values a step does not offer and steps unreachable from first; decrypt accepts only v1:iv:ct with a 12-byte IV; the email form posts; parseCatalog reports a repeated offer id; the TEST_ROUTES gate is tested on ON, empty and missing. Decisions by Arthur: test routes are on for the deployed demo (TEST_ROUTES is off in wrangler.jsonc and CI deploys with --var TEST_ROUTES:on), and everything user-facing is in English, so the no-offer text is "No offer available". Tooling added in the stage: a Claude Code PostToolUse hook runs oxfmt and oxlint on every edited file, and oxlint now runs the suspicious category and the vitest plugin and fails on warnings. Traps: `pnpm test -t "X"` filters, while `pnpm test -- -t "X"` runs everything; the global Env needs augmenting for typecheck without .dev.vars; secret values cannot be read back from Cloudflare, so .dev.vars.remote is the only copy. Deferred: no body size cap on /api/complete; re-seeding keeps an old partner secret (rotation per ADR 0007 is not built yet); two completions in the same millisecond keep the first; moving the identity middleware.
stages.verified: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm test (138 passed, 13 files); CI check job green on PR #2. GET /healthz, the remote seed, DEMO-2 and partner_secrets_ok are checked against the merge commit right after this commit deploys.
